scientific_integrity: A complete symbolic proof of the dyadic pushforward, finite-level fibre recurrence, moment threshold, and normalized collision formulas; finite tests corroborate but do not substitute for proof.
scientific_limitations: Only fixed even exponents with exactly one factor of two and at least six, modulo powers of two, for ordered two-variable sums.
No independence, absolute publication priority, other-prime statement, or global integer asymptotic is asserted.
Generic local-zeta or an unindexed diagonal-form result might imply part of the formulas.
title: Exact dyadic collision and integrability laws for two powers with \(d\equiv2\pmod4\)
